expected._comment: v7.37.6 — attack #1 (defer combined_vals materialise in try_streamed_inner_join_walk_topn) cut warm from 86ms to 7.9ms. Budgets tightened to warm <= 12ms / p95 <= 14ms with a small variance margin. f8669eca measured cold 9.84 / p50 7.22 / p95 8.91 ms over 100 iters on the prod snapshot and set each budget above what it measured; the previous v7.37.5 budgets (cold 110 / warm 100 / p95 110) would have let a 10x regression through. Note that cold is a single execution, so its budget is judged on n=1 while p50 and p95 come from 100 samples. v7.38.25 -- that 9.84 and today's cold are NOT the same quantity, and subtracting them produces a regression that is not there. When f8669eca measured it, opening this snapshot took 218-250 s and 99% of that was `replay_wal_filtered` re-executing 1040 V4 auto-commit SQL records at ~210 ms each (see .claude/notes/v7.37.7-A1-open-path-audit.md), so 9.84 ms was the engine's 1041st statement. Today the open is 3-4 s and this is its first. Measured on an idle testbed: cold 12.4-13.7, p50 6.35-7.18, p95 6.82-7.42 -- steady state is FASTER than the 7.22 / 8.91 recorded here, and an interleaved same-window run of f8669eca's own binary against HEAD found no difference in either. What is unexplained is the ~6 ms gap between this fixture's cold and its p50 on an idle machine; four attempts to attribute it were all made on a machine where that gap was not present, and were withdrawn. It only shows on a quiet box: under load the 100-sample p50 inflates faster than the single cold sample and the gap flattens or inverts. Before attributing it to anything, check that the run has it.
